content.rendered:
ntop was designed to be self-contained in order to avoid people configuration and usage headache. Unfortunately the drawback is that extending ntop has always been a difficult activity as users had to code in C and know ntop’s internals.

Recently thanks to the integration of ntop with Python, it is possible to script the application and add new features on the fly with minimal effort and no knowledge of how ntop works internally. This tutorial shows how the ntop+Python integration works, and it describes what users can do with it.
